about: The Rebbeim's portraits on their cards (the towns, the ohalim, 770; owner, Nov 6 2026: 'properly framed much better than shluchim'): web/img/rebbeim/<key>.jpg, a 4:5 head-and-shoulders crop at 300x375, made by scripts/head-photos/rebbeim-portraits.py from the source kept in work/head-photos/rebbeim/<key>.jpg ('box' is the crop in that source's pixels; 'fill', rare, is an area painted over with the backdrop first). The Alter Rebbe's and the Tzemach Tzedek's are the traditional portraits, not photographs; the Rebbe Rashab's, the Frierdiker Rebbe's and the Rebbe's are photographs. No likeness of the Mitteler Rebbe or of the Rebbe Maharash is known: on the map their frame holds their name.

portraits.note: photograph; a man behind him, out of focus at the top right, painted over with the dark backdrop
